name: Psyntient Ink & Gold v1.0
source: BRANDING.md (this directory) — full spec, read that first
notes: Supersedes the earlier placeholder theme.json from Phase C. Never ship purple/indigo-on-white; the Node ships dark-only.

avatar.concept: calm wise magical elf, arcane scholar
avatar.usage: avatar (no vignette) for in-chat message avatar; icon (vignetted) for a chat launcher, never the sidebar logo

logo.lockup: assets/psyntient-logo.png — full lockup, cream bg intentional, splash/installer/about only
logo.gapNote: no true 512px mark source yet — 512 variant is upscaled from a 263px crop; regenerate from a higher-res source lockup if a crisp 512 is needed

motion: slow, eased, never springy — 200ms color/opacity, 300ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) transform
rules: exactly one gold CTA per view
muted text is warm cream at lower opacity, never gray
elf only in Noetic Interface chat; mark everywhere else
no white flash on cold start
